title: the OCEAN is not your friend 🌊 | part 8
description: We know more about Mars than our own ocean floor. Part 9 tomorrow.
hook: The ocean is not your friend.
facts: We have better maps of Mars than of our own ocean floor.
A blue whale's heart is the size of a small car.
One jellyfish can age backwards. Basically immortal.
More than half of Earth's oxygen comes from the ocean.
The deepest point of the sea is deeper than Everest is tall.
outro: Follow for part nine. The water remembers.
